events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' on the world. What's your favourite track from this double LP masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true legend. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Classic Album
angles.copy: The sound of 1965 changed forever with The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arriving on this day. A true game-changer.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles icon John Lennon, who passed away in 1980 and would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist and advocate for peace, who would have been 86. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today we remember music icon David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Starman Remembered
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of the one and only David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. Forever a Starman.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: All shook up for Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. The King's legacy still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock and roll history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful voice of Paul Young! Still 'Wherever I Lay My Hat'.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today we remember country music icon Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and spirit shine on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true pop maestro.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Seventies
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' making us feel good.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction (1989)
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, music history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction. Who's your dream inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still shining bright.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Iconic Moment
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo superstar Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo success, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for 'Only Fools and Horses' and 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: This day marks the tragic plane crash in 1959 that killed rock and roll stars Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97).

angles.name: Forever Remembered
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on. #TheDayTheMusicDied

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop singer Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up'.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Remembering the timeless Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of 'One Love' resonates always.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Songwriting Genius
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the brilliant Carole King! A true songwriting icon whose music has touched generations.
